description: Counts and median GBP/m2 of other homes' recorded sales in the same building (postcode, house number or name, street) and on the same street (other buildings) as one address id, last 10 years. The median is withheld under 5 standard sales with an EPC floor area. Summary only: no sale rows and no addresses; homes with a privacy objection are left out. Coming soon: until Close Knit opens to assistants this tool answers status coming-soon, no data.
name: get_nearby_sales_summary
title: Get nearby sales summary
